comprehensiveAnalysis.executiveSummary: Muse Med Spa (musemed.com) at 265 S 3rd St in downtown Columbus, OH offers Botox, dermal fillers, HydraFacials, laser hair removal, and accredited injector training led by providers Tessa and Jana (4.5★ across 38 Google reviews) while running Meta Pixel campaigns. However, the WordPress website suffers from the slowest mobile speed in the cohort: TTFB is 8.3 seconds, mobile LCP is 22.2 seconds (22,164 ms), and full page load takes 33.5 seconds (33,537 ms) due to 5.0 MB of unoptimized images. Visually and functionally, it scores 3/10 on UX/CRO: an oversized background watermark clashes with right-column copy containing a 'NATURALRESULTS.' typo, there are 0 interactive forms or self-serve booking widgets on the homepage (usesMailtoOnly: true), and recent patient feedback (Mitchell Gresley) cites months of scheduling friction trying to redeem prepaid promotional gift cards.

Our UX lead already mocked up a custom luxury editorial homepage redesign for Muse Med Spa.

My UX partner and I work directly as two senior principals handling design, speed, and 24/7 AI intake. Mind if I reply with the side-by-side redesign image and the diagnostic breakdown we put together for Muse Med Spa?
